newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds recover, Bund spreads steady.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds recover, Bund spreads steady.

text.p: 1625 GMT - Portuguese bonds recovered at the close in line with Bunds after a weak start. Spreads vs Bunds steady.
*Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 67 bps vs 69 bps cls
Portuguese bonds recovered at the close after a weak start and yield spreads against Bunds were steady, dealers said.
"For the time being, spreads against 10-year Bunds should remain steady at around 67 basis points," a dealer said.
Another said: "The market recovered from the drop this morning, and remained in sympathy with Bunds."
